sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Huntsman Path - Big Game is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I recently came across a family in the woods, a father and his son. Both were exhausted, and the boy had taken a bullet. I brought them back to my place, patched the kid up, and fed them both. The father told me they didn't make it out during the evacuation. Later, some bandits took them in like livestock. Forced them to work at an auto shop, with a bullet to the head as the alternative. Their leader goes by Kaban. Apparently, he's a respected man among them. The two of them escaped during the night and somehow made it through the gunfire into the woods, where I found them. The boy's wound was too severe. He didn't make it through the night. So, to the point. If another gang of criminals has taken root in this city, then you and I need to deal with them. Avenge that father's loss, and make sure something like this doesn't happen to anyone else again."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"One less scumbag to worry about. You did well, kid."
